questions.qEn: Please introduce your team.
questions.a: 저희 팀의 이름은 다소 길지만, 그만큼 역할이 폭넓고 중요한 분야를 담당하고 있습니다. ‘친환경전략 및 차량중량관리팀(Environmental Strategy & Mass Team)’은 기후변화로 현실화된 지구온난화 문제에 자동차 분야가 어떻게 대응해야 하는지 전략적으로 고민하고 실행하는 팀입니다. 정부 규제에 대응하여 회사의 연간 이산화탄소 배출량을 체계적으로 관리하고 경영 리스크를 최소화하는 역할을 맡고 있습니다. 최근에는 규제 범위가 차량의 제조부터 폐기까지 전 과정을 아우르는 LCA(Life Cycle Assessment)로 확대됨에 따라, 전 생애주기 기반의 정교한 환경 전략 수립에 집중하고 있습니다. 또한 탄소 저감의 핵심인 차량 경량화를 위해 제품 개발 단계에서 중량 목표를 설정하고 최적화하며, GM의 제품이 더욱 지속 가능한 방향으로 나아가도록 이끌고 있습니다.

questions.aEn:
Our team’s name is a bit long, but it reflects the breadth and importance of our responsibilities. The Environmental Strategy & Mass Team is responsible for thinking strategically—and putting into action—how the automotive sector should respond to climate change and the very real problem of global warming. We manage the company’s annual CO₂ emissions in a systematic way to comply with government regulations and to minimize business risk.

Recently, as regulations have expanded to cover the entire vehicle life cycle from production to end-of-life through LCA (Life Cycle Assessment), we have been focusing on building more sophisticated, life-cycle-based environmental strategies. In addition, to drive vehicle lightweighting—the core of carbon reduction—we set and optimize mass targets from the product development stage, helping GM products move in a more sustainable direction.

questions.aEn: Including our team leader, we are a relatively large team of 17 people. As a result, everyone demonstrates strong ownership and immersion in their work, exercising autonomy while delivering deep expertise in their domain. Seeing my teammates’ genuine attitude and professionalism every day makes me feel that our team is truly impressive and something to be proud of.

questions.q: 내게 GMTCK란?

questions.qEn: What does GMTCK mean to you?
questions.a: GMTCK는 제 인생의 첫 직장이자 마지막까지 함께하고 싶은 소중한 회사입니다. GM의 대표 연구소로 자리 잡았던 영광스러운 순간부터 여러 위기와 변화의 시기까지 함께 겪어왔고, 그때마다 직원들이 힘을 모아 극복하는 모습을 보며 큰 자부심을 느껴왔습니다. 최근 기술 변화의 속도는 과거와 비교할 수 없을 만큼 빠르게 진행되고 있습니다. 자동차 산업 역시 지난 몇 년간 엄청난 변화를 겪고 있으며, 앞으로도 새 도전들이 이어질 것입니다. 하지만 저는 우리 연구소 구성원 한 사람 한 사람이 슬기롭게 미래를 준비하고 있다고 믿고 있습니다. 그리고 이러한 변화의 흐름 속에서도 GMTCK가 GM의 대표 연구소로 영원히 성장하고 발전해 나가기를 진심으로 소망합니다.

questions.aEn:
GMTCK is my first workplace and a company I hope to stay with until the end of my career. I’ve experienced both the proud moments when it established itself as one of GM’s flagship technical centers and the various crises and transitions along the way, and each time I’ve felt great pride seeing our employees come together and overcome challenges.

Recently, the pace of technological change has become incomparable to the past. The automotive industry has gone through tremendous shifts over the last few years, and many new challenges still lie ahead. Even so, I believe every member of our technical center is preparing wisely for the future. And amid these waves of change, I sincerely hope that GMTCK will continue to grow and thrive as one of GM’s leading technical centers.

questions.aEn: The System Engineering organization is responsible for improving engineering quality and safety from a system-integration perspective. Rather than focusing on individual parts, we look at how multiple systems interact across the entire vehicle and, in that process, what risks and quality issues may arise. Identifying these system-level concerns early is at the heart of what we do.

questions.aEn: I am responsible for system safety, defining and managing risks that may arise throughout the vehicle’s entire lifecycle. I review test results and issues reported by Design, Performance, and Validation teams from a safety perspective and, when necessary, request design changes or additional validation. In addition to development-stage issues, I also analyze field data, building solid technical justification that can stand up to scrutiny during future product investigations.

questions.a: 제가 있는 Systems Excellence and Safety Team은 시스템 관점에서 엔지니어링 품질과 안전을 동시에 끌어올리는 조직입니다. 팀 안에는 기능 안전 전문가 뿐만 아니라 DFMEA·신뢰성, 검증 방법론을 담당하는 다양한 엔지니어들이 함께 있고, 이슈가 생기면 세이프티 관점에서 리스크를 정리하는 사람, 설계 검토 관점에서 재발 방지책을 고민하는 사람, 검증·품질 쪽에서 실행 플랜을 짜는 사람이 붙어서 하나의 스토리로 정리합니다.

questions.aEn: The Systems Excellence and Safety Team is an organization that raises engineering quality and safety from a systems perspective. Within the team, we have not only functional safety specialists, but also engineers responsible for DFMEA, reliability, and validation methodology. When an issue arises, the right people come together: someone organizes the risks from a safety perspective, someone else develops recurrence-prevention measures from a design-review standpoint, and another person in validation/quality builds the execution plan. Together, we consolidate these into one coherent story.

questions.a: 프로그램의 개발 단계별로 안전 요구사항을 문서화하고, 각 단계에 맞춰 안전 레벨을 부여하는 일이 기본입니다. 해당 프로그램 개발자, 밸리데이션 엔지니어들과 리뷰 미팅을 통해 시험 결과나 설계 변경 사항을 세이프티 관점에서 점검합니다. 큰 틀에서 보면, 리스크를 판단하고 그 판단을 문서와 말로 설득력 있게 남기는 일이 하루를 채우고 있습니다.

I hold review meetings with program developers and validation engineers to examine test results and design changes from a safety perspective. questions.aEn:
If you’re interested in this role, you don’t need to be a safety expert from day one. However, it really helps to develop the habit of mentally tracing through what could happen step by step if a system problem occurs—following the chain of events all the way to the end.

Another important trait is the courage to ask questions in meetings instead of hiding what you don’t know. System Safety often starts from the assumption that “something could go wrong,” so this role tends to be a good fit for people who are naturally willing to question things and openly explore potential problems.

questions.a: 우리 팀의 가장 큰 장점은 서로를 ‘서로의 전문성을 존중하는 파트너’로 본다는 점입니다. 각자 맡은 시스템에 대한 책임은 분명하지만, 막히는 부분이 생기면 자연스럽게 옆자리로 가서 의견을 구하거나 채널에 이슈를 올려 같이 토론하는 문화가 자리 잡혀 있습니다. 특히 북미에서 오신 팀장님이 실을 이끌고 계셔서, 자유로운 분위기 속에서도 이슈나 프로젝트의 작은 안건까지 서스럼없이 의견을 공유할 수 있습니다. 동시에 각자가 자기 일정과 우선순위를 스스로 관리하면서 꽤 높은 수준의 독립성을 가지고 일합니다. 서로 방해하지 않으면서도 필요할 때는 바로 옆에서 받쳐주는 구조라, 개인과 팀 모두가 성장하기 좋은 환경이라고 느끼고 있습니다.

questions.aEn:
The biggest strength of our team is that we see one another as “partners who respect each other’s expertise.” Everyone has clear ownership of their own systems, but when someone gets stuck, it’s natural to walk over to a colleague’s desk for input or post an issue in a channel and discuss it together. Our team is led by a manager from North America, so even in a very open atmosphere we feel comfortable sharing opinions on issues and even small project topics without hesitation.

It’s a structure where we don’t interfere with each other’s work, but we’re right there to support one another when needed, and I feel it’s an environment where both individuals and the whole team can really grow.

It’s also the place where I can watch system and safety theories, which was seen on paper only, being verified and refined on real cars and customer data, up close. At times it feels burdensome, but just as often I’m motivated by the thought that “if I do this job well, someone out there will get home more safely.”

One of the most impressive projects  was building a simulation of real-vehicle test environments (radio reception conditions) for Europe and the Middle East. For this project, we collaborated with many engineers at MPG, recording radio waves and electric-field data on site in Europe to secure the source signals, and then creating a lab environment capable of transmitting them in compliance with relevant regulations and specifications.

Because we also had to evaluate the completeness of systems using vehicles under development, we conducted extensive discussions and validation on transmission methods, test conditions, and equipment setups. After about a year of meetings and experiments, we successfully established the simulation environment, which is now effectively replacing on-site vehicle testing in Europe.

questions.qEn: What is PVE General Work?
questions.a: PVE는 프로그램 단위의 검증(Validation) 활동을 체계적으로 운영하며, 조직 구성부터 정기 보고까지 프로그램 전반의 진행 현황을 조율하는 컨트롤 타워 역할을 수행합니다. 개발 일정 내에서 검증이 완료될 수 있도록 Timing과 S&O, GVBE (Global Vehicle and Bench Exception) 프로세스를 관리하고, LADV (Learning / Analysis / Development / Validation) 계획 수립과 시험용 부품 확보를 위한 PPPR (Pre-Production Property Request) 등의 자원 관리를 병행합니다. 또한 규제 항목 점검(RCL)과 품질 준비 상태 확인(PQRR)을 통해 프로세스의 완결성을 높이며, 특히 양산 승인의 핵심 게이트인 PVCL을 운영하여 차량의 안전과 품질을 최종적으로 공식화합니다. 이를 위해 각 분야의 전문가 및 리더십과 긴밀히 협업하여 검증 상태를 관리하고, 글로벌 조직 간의 업무 분담과 변경 사항을 체계적으로 조율합니다. PRTS (Problem Resolution and Tracking System) 시스템을 활용해 문제 해결 현황을 실시간으로 추적, 보고하며, 시험 목적에 맞는 차량이 적시에 제작되도록 Build Order 관리 업무까지 책임집니다. 결과적으로 PVE는 단순한 보고를 넘어 개발 책임과 양산 승인을 직접 연결함으로써, 고객에게 최상의 품질을 가진 완성차를 제공하는 핵심적인 역할을 합니다.

questions.aEn: PVE runs program-level validation in a structured way and acts as a control tower—aligning overall program progress from organization setup through regular reporting. To finish validation within the development schedule, we manage Timing, S&O, and the GVBE (Global Vehicle and Bench Exception) process, and we also handle resources such as the LADV (Learning / Analysis / Development / Validation) plan and PPPR (Pre-Production Property Request) for test parts. Regulatory checks (RCL) and quality readiness reviews (PQRR) strengthen process closure, and we operate PVCL, the key gate for production approval, to formally finalize vehicle safety and quality. We work closely with subject-matter experts and leadership to manage validation status and systematically align global work share and changes. In short, PVE goes beyond reporting—it links development accountability directly to production approval and plays a central role in delivering finished vehicles with the highest quality to customers.

저한테 GMTCK는 "고객이 느끼는 품질을 실제 차량으로 구현해 보는 실험실이자, 계속 성장할 수 있는 무대"에 가깝습니다.

questions.aEn:
I believe the most important capability is the combination of curiosity and the ability to integrate technology. Because AI technologies evolve so rapidly, maintaining continuous curiosity about new technologies is essential. At the same time, we must constantly ask, “What kind of value can this technology actually create in the engineering field?”

In addition, the AI Core Team is not a group that deals only with technology itself. We play a role in connecting AI technologies with real business challenges, and in linking people with people, and data with decision-making. This is why, alongside technical understanding, it is critical to understand and communicate with each organization’s workflows. Through this kind of connection, we strive to integrate domain expertise with AI.
